article.story: DAVIDSON, N.C. -- — Josh Scovens scored 19 points as Davidson beat Fordham 68-63 on Wednesday night. Scovens also had three steals for the Wildcats (12-6, 4-2 Atlantic 10 Conference). Roberts Blums scored 14 points while going 5 of 10 from the floor, including 2 for 6 from 3-point range, and 2 for 4 from the line and added three steals. Dejour Reaves finished with 22 points for the Rams (10-10, 1-6). Jack Whitbourn added 11 points. Blums scored six points in the first half and Davidson went into the break trailing 30-26. Scovens scored 17 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
